description:
## [1.19.0](https://github.com/callMeBeyonder/morphe-patches/compare/v1.18.0...v1.19.0) (2026-11-16)

### ✨ New Features

* **juggernautai:** add Unlock Premium patch for 3.1.0 ([ae8f720](https://github.com/callMeBeyonder/morphe-patches/commit/ae8f720ab585e4354e586cce452441d0b5b30dae))

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Reports the account as premium by forcing the stored `is_premium` check to true and the `membership_tier` getter to the `Standard` tier, which unlocks the paid workout, class, program, benchmark and profile surfaces. Billing is untouched; media the server refuses to serve to free accounts may still fail to load.

patches.name: Bypass PairIP checks
patches.description: Disables PairIP's native VM, signature check and Play licence verdicts so a re-signed build does not open the Play Store listing or crash, and restores the VM-relocated string literals captured from the genuine build. Experimental: three VM-virtualized receiver/background methods fall back to default return values.

patches.name: Unlock Pro
patches.description: Unlocks all Pro features by forcing the web app's own client-side subscription gate (`proVersion.isActive` and the `pro-version` body class) to active. RevenueCat, Play Billing and the account's real server-side entitlement are left untouched.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks the Pro surfaces that are computed on-device (Strength Score, per-muscle volume heatmap, auto-progression and the analytics screens) by reporting an active RevenueCat entitlement to the app's JavaScript layer. Server-delivered coach programs still require a real subscription.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks the Zen Unlimited Pass: every plan week, the Zen Powered Music Mixes, the member Fitness Plans page and the Settings Unsubscribe entry, and hides the drawer's buy-product item. Billing is untouched.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks the Zen Unlimited Pass: every plan week, the Zen Powered Music Mixes, the member Fitness Plans page and the Settings Unsubscribe entry, and hides the drawer's buy-product item. Billing is untouched.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks the Zen Unlimited Pass features: removes ads and enables workout stats, workouts, music, height/weight and achievement stats.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks the Zen Unlimited Pass: every plan week, the Zen Powered Music Mixes, the member Fitness Plans page and the Settings Unsubscribe entry, and hides the drawer's buy-product item. Billing is untouched.

patches.name: Custom seek step
patches.description: Lets the seek distance of the player's left/right keys be set inside the app. Applies to the D-pad and to the media rewind/fast-forward keys, and adds "Seek 30s/1m/5m/10m/30m" choices to the SPEED tab of the player settings panel.

options.description: Used until a step is chosen in the player settings panel. Default 300 (5 minutes), allowed 1-3600.

patches.name: Disable forced update
patches.description: Hides the blocking update dialog and the update prompt.

patches.name: Prefer highest resolution
patches.description: Starts playback at the best available resolution instead of the built-in 480p default. An explicit choice in the settings panel still takes precedence.

patches.name: Serve requested resolution
patches.description: Uses the signed DASH streams of the mobile play-info endpoint, so 480p/720p/1080p/4K actually select a real video track instead of reloading the same low-res MP4. Falls back to the TV streams when the mobile ladder is unavailable or lower.

patches.name: Unlock VIP
patches.description: Reports the account as VIP, clears the per-title VIP locks and removes the visitor region block.

patches.name: Bypass integrity check
patches.description: Disables the native tamper check that makes a re-signed build fail to decrypt the server configuration on startup.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Removes the sponsor ads (banner and gate screens) and the full-screen ads. The locked channel dialog is kept.

patches.name: Remove bandwidth sharing (CashRaven)
patches.description: Disables the CashRaven P2P bandwidth-sharing SDK: no opt-in, no background sharing service, no restart on boot, and the sharing menu entry is hidden.

patches.name: Remove unnecessary permissions
patches.description: Removes the boot-persistence, advertising-ID, install-referrer and package-query permissions the patched build no longer needs.

patches.name: Bypass Root Detection
patches.description: Removes the root-detection block so the app can be used on rooted devices.

patches.name: Remove analytics
patches.description: Stops Firebase Analytics and CleverTap reporting, AppsFlyer attribution, and Facebook automatic app events/advertiser-ID collection. CleverTap push/in-app initialisation is disabled; crash reporting and Branch deep links are kept.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks premium and freemium features in the app, including the full macro and micronutrient breakdown for food items and the dashboard freemium card locks, locked-state CTAs (e.g. "Unlock Macros"), and the expired-trial tag chips. Server-delivered content such as diet plans, coaching, and AI features may still require a real subscription.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks Carbon Premium by forcing the app's `isSubscribed` reads to true, stubbing `hasActiveSubscription()` and the RevenueCat entitlement readers (`activeProductId()`, `activeProductPlanId()`, `subscriptionState()`) to a canned active yearly entitlement. Account data the server owns is not affected.

patches.name: Disable Expo OTA updates
patches.description: Stops the app from downloading a production JavaScript bundle over the embedded one. Required by bundle patches so a later Expo update cannot replace the patched JavaScript.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks all premium programs by initialising the app's own `SUBSCRIPTION_ENABLED` config flag to false at module init. That is the flag the paywall, the Subscription screen guard, the IAPHUB sync and the walkthrough check all read, so the app runs in its "subscriptions not live" mode: no paywall, premium programs selectable. Expo OTA updates are disabled so a downloaded JS bundle cannot overwrite the patched one. Store and server-side data are not affected.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks all premium content by forcing every premium gate ("true"===this.state.premium) and every premium flag seed to true in the web bundle.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks the premium training features by answering the web app's subscription request with an active `training` subscription, and disables the PairIP license check so the re-signed build does not open its paywall. Account data that the server owns is not affected.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Reports an active `premium` entitlement to Runna's JavaScript layer, clears the backend's client-side plan lock flags and subscription status, unlocking premium screens, all plan weeks and the plan footer without a Play purchase.

patches.name: Unlock Premium (Root)
patches.description: Unlocks all premium features. Requires root: the patched build must be mounted over the genuine Play-signed install — a re-signed sideload will not work.

patches.name: Unlock Premium (Root)
patches.description: Unlocks all premium features. Requires root: the patched build must be mounted over the genuine Play-signed install — a re-signed sideload will not work.

patches.name: Unlock Pro (Root)
patches.description: Unlocks all Pro and PowerPack features. Requires root: the patched build must be mounted over the genuine Play-signed install — a normal sideload will not run.
